authorizes: P1-18 Student V2 on Modal A10 under the owner's separate V2 + follow-up bucket of $70 (owner authorization 2026-11-10, single owner, chat: 'V1 $31 + V2 $70'). Phases: pilot $0.5 (not planned: same code and R as V1), train $25, eval $6.5; 0 retries, 1 container. The rest of the $70 bucket (DAgger rollouts and fine-tune) needs its own protocol version.

method.stage_1: weighted multi-teacher SFT on coherent complete joint-action class-A demonstrations (docs/P1_14_STUDENT_TRAINING_METHOD.md)
method.stage_2: DPO/IPO on approved class-C same-state preferences; needs its own freeze
method.stage_3: student-visited states (class E); blocked until P1-16
method.objective: student_objective.sft_nll: -log pi(A|s) / N per decision, chain rule over chunk rows

teachers.identity: provenance only; never a model input, never a weight
teachers.superseded: P1-11 T1-only protocol (PR #42/#44) is not a source of pins' permissions or of training rights

pins.source: model identity facts copied from data/training/p1-11-student@1/protocol.json (PR #44 branch); identities only

data.dataset_protocol: data/protocols/p1-18-multiteacher-dataset.json 1.1.0 (FROZEN; = P1-14 1.0.0 with the p1-18-expand@1 TRAIN partition allowed)
data.examples: student_ingest.prepare_examples: selected, weighted class-A whole joint maps only
data.sampling: student_ingest.sample_epoch: weight-proportional draws with replacement to a fixed token budget
data.token_budget_per_epoch: FIXED before any V1 or V2 result: B = 128,701,152 tokens = V1's B (spec-train.json of p1-18-v1-train@1), so V1 and V2 get the same training compute and differ only in data. If the V2 full pass is smaller than B, B = the V2 full pass. Epoch = student_ingest.sample_epoch(seed=training.epoch_seed, token_budget=B).
data.truncation: forbidden: a non-OK row stops the run
data.sft: expand_dataset.sft: train = every p1-17-sft@1 train example (unchanged) + every selected, weighted class-A example of the p1-18-expand@1 TRAIN partition (220 families); val = p1-17-sft@1 val unchanged (same 6 families as V1). Expansion val/diagnostic, DEV, calibration and the locked test never enter training.

token_measurement.host_check: the GPU container re-counts every epoch row with the loaded tokenizer; any mismatch stops the run

adapter.target: all linear layers of the backbone

training.checkpoints: every 250 optimizer steps (resume only) and at the end

compute.before_paid_job: read actual Modal spend; stop and ask for a budget decision if the job could exceed the remaining budget

evaluation.strategy_mixing_check: on same-state class-A conflicts, measure whether the factorized student emits a joint map no teacher proposed and whether it is worse; if so, compare bounded global strategy conditioning before any larger architecture change

pilot.epoch: sample_epoch(seed=training.epoch_seed, token_budget=1500000): a prefix of the training epoch draws
checks: encoder length and one-hot targets inside option masks
first-step LoRA and head gradient norms > 0
checkpoint save + reload: same argmax on probe rows
